//: Copy to appsettings.Development.json (untracked) and fill in. The real file used to be committed, which put a working JWT signing key and the database password in a public repository.

TokenSettings.//: Any random value of at least 32 bytes. Local only — JwtSecretGuard refuses to start outside Development if it sees the old committed key.

Bootstrap.//: Any random value of at least 20 bytes. Required to call POST /api/v1/authentication/sign-up (X-Bootstrap-Key header) — public sign-up is closed, only the platform admin holds this.

ConnectionStrings.//: Port 3307 is the MySQL container from compose.yaml. Put the same password you set as BODEGA_DB_PASSWORD in .env — literal here, since this file is untracked.
